summary: ECOVIS Clark Jacobs is an independently owned member of the ECOVIS network with offices in Sydney (Walsh Bay), Brisbane and Perth; its own site lists no Melbourne office, which conflicts with the Melbourne St Kilda Rd address in the account record. Andrew Pratt is a current Manager at the firm, has 13+ years in public practice, works with family groups and high net worth clients, and co-owns two veterinary businesses. The firm positions itself around medical, dental and veterinary professionals, family offices and business owners.

hooks.text: Andrew co-owns two veterinary businesses and works at a firm built around vet, medical and dental practices, so he sees reconciliation from both the adviser and the owner side.
Family-group and high net worth work means many entities and bank accounts per client to reconcile.
Management reporting and outsourced bookkeeping offering relies on timely, trustworthy reconciliations.

risks.text: Location mismatch: the account record says Melbourne (616 St Kilda Rd, which appears to be another firm's building), but the firm's own site lists only Sydney, Brisbane and Perth offices and Andrew Pratt is Sydney-based. Confirm the right firm/office before sending.

Sokveasna Toek has no email on record and her LinkedIn mentions a separate Managing Director role at 'ECOVIS Scott & Partners' (Jun 2026), so a Melbourne arm or rebrand may exist that could not be confirmed.
Andrew is a Manager rather than a director/partner, so he may not be the buyer; the firm is a seven-partner Sydney practice part of an international network.

gaps: No firm blog, newsletter, podcast, news or Facebook content found.
No job ads found for the firm.
Could not confirm any Melbourne office; the ecovis.com.au site timed out with an SSL error so the ecovisclarkjacobs.com.au site was used.
No evidence found of accounting automation tools (Dext, Hubdoc, Karbon etc.).
